name: Holašovice Historic Village
description: Holašovice is a small village in South Bohemia, about 16 kilometres west of České Budějovice. Around a broad, rectangular green, neat rows of 18th- and 19th-century farmhouses show off ornate gabled fronts in a style called South Bohemian folk Baroque. The village was largely abandoned after the Second World War, which saved its medieval layout, and it has been lovingly restored since 1990.
